title: Online B.Com in FinTech Course | UGC Entitled & NAAC A+
description: Pursue an online B.Com with FinTech elective at DSU Online. Learn digital payments, blockchain, cryptocurrency & RegTech. NAAC A+ accredited.  Apply now!

blocks.x: Digital Payments | Blockchain | Cryptocurrency | Financial Innovation | RegTech

FinTech combines finance and technology to revolutionize financial services through digital innovation. This elective provides comprehensive knowledge of digital payments, blockchain technology, cryptocurrency, and regulatory technology. Students learn to develop financial applications, understand digital banking systems, and explore emerging technologies like AI in finance. The program prepares learners for careers in digital banking, payment systems, investment technology, and financial innovation across traditional and startup environments.
Mobile payments, digital wallets, UPI systems, and payment gateway integrations.
Distributed ledger systems, smart contracts, and blockchain applications in finance.
Digital currencies, trading platforms, DeFi protocols, and crypto market analysis.
Online banking systems, neo-banking, API banking, and financial service platforms.
Regulatory technology, compliance automation, risk management, and financial security.
Machine learning for fraud detection, algorithmic trading, and automated financial advisory.
